title: Self-Improving Prompts System
description: Complete the self-improving prompts system with retro command and smart suggestions.

title: Add ralph retro command
description:
Implement the `ralph retro` command that:
1. Reads LEARNINGS.md
2. Uses opus to analyze patterns and consolidate learnings
3. Proposes changes to RULES.md
4. Outputs a summary of proposed changes
5. Supports `--apply` flag to apply changes

The retro prompt should:
- Identify duplicate/related learnings
- Consolidate them into single entries
- Propose promoting patterns to RULES.md
- Suggest archiving stale learnings

Create cmd/ralph/retro.go and internal/retro/retro.go

title: Add smart retro suggestions to run output
description:
At the end of `ralph run`, check if retro should be suggested:
- Provisional learnings > 10
- Days since last retro > 7  
- Failure rate > 30%

Output a message like:
"Retro suggested: 12 new learnings, 3 confirmed patterns. Run: ralph retro"

Track last retro time in .ralph/state.json or similar.

title: Write unit tests for learnings package
description:
Add tests for internal/learnings/learnings.go:
- Test Add() with new learning
- Test Add() with exact duplicate (should skip)
- Test Add() with fuzzy match (should promote)
- Test Load() and Save() round-trip
- Test GetRecent() time filtering
- Test similarity() function
- Test parseLearnings() parser

Create internal/learnings/learnings_test.go

title: Write unit tests for analyzer package
description:
Add tests for internal/analyzer/analyzer.go:
- Test parseAnalysisOutput() with valid JSON
- Test parseAnalysisOutput() with invalid JSON
- Test parseAnalysisOutput() with JSON embedded in text
- Test LearningCategory() mapping

Create internal/analyzer/analyzer_test.go

title: Add PROMPT_analyze.md template
description:
The analyzer currently builds the prompt inline in analyzer.go.
Move it to a template file at .ralph/templates/PROMPT_analyze.md for consistency.

Update:
1. Add defaultAnalyzeTemplate to cmd/ralph/init.go
2. Update internal/analyzer to load template from file
3. Add AnalyzeContext struct to prompt package

title: Add PROMPT_retro.md template
description:
Create template for the retro analysis prompt.

The template should instruct Claude to:
1. Review all learnings (confirmed and provisional)
2. Identify themes and patterns
3. Consolidate duplicate/related learnings
4. Propose additions to RULES.md
5. Suggest learnings to archive

Output should be structured JSON with proposed changes.
